limitations: Five dev questions; sparse source-span labels; no new generated answers or reranking calls, and no end-to-end timing comparison. All 5 original B0 evidence lists reproduced exactly. No held-out questions used.
procedure: Load and validate the saved unreranked B0 dev candidate pools; for each unchanged question retrieve BM25 top-20 over all indexed papers, fuse with the original dense top-20 using RRF constant 60 and cap 20; replay each dense/fused pool through RetrievalService with reranking disabled; score final evidence and the deduplicated pre-packing pool using the unchanged source-span metric. Persist source run/hash, component rankings, fused scores and final source chunk IDs. Resolve chunk IDs through the active metadata.sqlite for original text/spans.
